newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler down sharply after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Daimler down sharply after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Daimler-Benz AG fell about five percent from their session peak on Thursday due to profit-taking after the German industrial group reported half-year results generally in line with market expectations.

Daimler shares were down 5.30 marks to 154.00 marks after the Stuttgart-based group said six-month group operating profit under U.S. GAAP rules rose to 1.849 billion marks from 827 million marks in the year-ago period.
Dealers noted Daimler shares had gained about nine percent this week, setting a new record high earlier on Thursday at 161.80 marks from last Friday's bourse close at 148.80 marks.
"This is purely a technical reaction to the results being issued after such gains," said one Frankfurt dealer.
But some dealers said the Daimler results were at the lower end of expectations for an operating profit of about two billion marks.
"The numbers were below our expectations, as well as some others that were at the top end," said another Frankfurt dealer at a major domestic bank. "Some people are a bit disappointed."
